connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: ✓ Logged in to app.example. A second browser, using only the saved login, saw "Workspace ready".
detail: Saved as profile app-example.
Next time: npx auspex check --profile app-example --url https://app.example/dash --expect "Workspace ready" --verify-with-profile

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: The live browser saw "Workspace ready", but a second browser using only the saved login did not confirm it.
detail: Do not reuse profile app-example yet. Run the same command again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: The live browser saw "Workspace ready", but a second browser using only the saved login did not confirm it.
detail: Do not reuse profile app-example yet. Run the same command again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: The app is on screen, but only your Microsoft or Google sign-in was saved, not the app's own login.
detail: Signing in again will not change that for this app, so Auspex stops here instead of guessing.
Why: https://github.com/IronAdamant/auspex/blob/main/RECEIPTS.md#two-truths

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Save happened while the Microsoft or Google sign-in page was still showing.
detail: Run the same command again. Finish signing in until the app itself is on screen, then save.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Solari could not save the login (HTTP 502: Failed to export storageState). That is on Solari's side, not your sign-in.
detail: Nothing was saved or claimed. Run the same command again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Solari could not save the login (HTTP 502: Failed to export storageState, again on a retry 5 s later). That is on Solari's side, not your sign-in.
detail: Nothing was saved or claimed. Run the same command again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: No Save arrived in time.
detail: Run the same command again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Solari said the remote browser could not be saved right then (HTTP 409: The editor isn't in a savable state.).
detail: Nothing was saved or claimed. Run the same command again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: The five-minute sign-in window closed before Save.
detail: Solari sets that window and Auspex cannot extend it.
Run the same command again. The new door reopens the same cloud browser while Solari keeps it, so a sign-in under way can carry on. Save as soon as the app is on screen.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: The saved login hit a password or code screen. Auspex never types those.
detail: Run the same command again. Complete every sign-in step (tick "Stay signed in" if offered) before saving.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: The remote browser ended up on a different site (https://other.example).
detail: If that is the app you meant, run: npx auspex connect https://other.example

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Nothing was saved. The remote browser had no login for this site yet.
detail: Run the same command again. Save only once the logged-in app is on screen.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: "Workspace ready" also appears on a public or login page, so it cannot prove you are logged in.
detail: Run again with words that only appear inside the app (for example a menu item or your workspace name).

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: A fresh browser with the saved login landed on a logged-out page.
detail: Run the same command again. Make sure the app is fully loaded before saving.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: The saved login opened the app, but "Workspace ready" was not on the page.
detail: Check the words (they are case-sensitive) and the URL, then run again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Solari says too many browsers are open on this key (HTTP 429).
detail: Auspex closed the ones it opened. Wait a minute, then run again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Solari or the site did not answer in time.
detail: Run the same command again.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: www.canva.com showed a bot check ("Just a moment…") to the fresh cloud browser, so Auspex could not confirm the login.
detail: That is the site blocking cloud browsers, not a failed sign-in. Auspex does not solve bot checks.
Running it again will likely hit the same check.

connectOutcome({\"schemaVersion\":1,\"jo.headline: Solari's browser closed during the check, and the SDK lost the error status (cookbook #56).
detail: Your login did save. Retry just the check once:
npx auspex check --profile canva-com --url https://www.canva.com/ --expect "Templates for you" --verify-with-profile
